patterns.note: A full-width dark hero section transitions sharply into a constrained-width, light-background content area, which then flows into a full-width dark footer separated by a distinctive wave shape.
The main hero heading uses a very large, bold sans-serif font, creating a strong visual anchor against the dark background, while body text is a more modest sans-serif.
The site primarily uses a high-contrast dark theme for the hero and footer, with a clean white background for the extensive instructional content, punctuated by subtle purple accents and gradients.
The top banner and main navigation bar become sticky after initial scroll, with the navigation gaining a solid dark background as it fixes to the top of the viewport.
The main content area is structured as a very long, documentation-style page, featuring numerous instructional sections with headings, descriptive text, and embedded video players.

technique_notes: The hero section features an auto-playing video background that scrolls beneath the main title and hexagonal partner grid. The top navigation and a promotional banner are fixed to the top of the viewport after the initial scroll, with the navigation bar adopting a solid background to maintain readability over scrolling content. Content sections reveal by simply scrolling into view without complex animations, relying on the page's long-form structure. A custom SVG or image asset is used to create a wavy visual separator between the main content and the footer.

design_tokens.type_scale: oversized bold hero heading (~3-4x body) with standard body text and smaller, regular labels.
design_tokens.radius: subtle rounded corners on cards and embedded elements, otherwise sharp.
design_tokens.spacing: airy in the hero section, balanced to dense in the long-form content areas, with a consistent vertical rhythm for instructional blocks.

standout: This site stands out for its unique blend of a modern, dark video-hero with a hexagonal partner grid, immediately transitioning into an exceptionally long, documentation-style content page. The extensive, detailed content, combined with the distinct wavy footer, creates a highly authoritative and comprehensive feel, rather than a typical marketing page.
